basis.governing_question: How can Metalúrgica Norte cut conversion cost at its Braga plant and put the improvements in place?

sub_questions.question: What is conversion cost per part at the Braga plant today, and where does it build up?
Which improvements can lower conversion cost per part by a measurable amount, and how much is each worth?
How are the chosen improvements put in place at the plant, and in what order?
Do the improvements keep running at the plant, and does cost per part fall against the baseline?

work.unit: Site diagnosed on the floor (cost baseline, line observation, loss analysis)

phase_work.why: One plant, so one site diagnosed on the floor; interviews run alongside. Estimate sits inside the archetype's typical 3 to 6 weeks.

work.unit: Pilot site: changes made and savings shown in the cost data

phase_work.why: The single plant is the pilot site; no rollout wave is needed. Estimate sits inside the archetype's typical 8 to 16 weeks.

sizing.levers: Carry only the largest sized improvements into Implementation, which holds most of the weeks; running changes side by side would also shorten it.

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Establish conversion cost per part at the Braga plant and size the improvements that could lower it.

gate.label: Initiatives go/no-go
gate.decision: Which sized initiatives go into implementation at the plant, and which stop here?

phases.name: Implementation
phases.objective_one_line: Put the agreed improvements in place at the plant and show their effect on conversion cost per part.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Approve the results against the baseline and the handover to the plant team?

architect_notes: Engagement length is not given; the 13 to 16 weeks are an estimate to confirm before this plan becomes a quote.
Implementation takes the middle of its 8 to 12 week estimate; savings slow to show in the cost data would push it to 12.
No Measurement phase: tracking against the baseline stays inside Implementation; confirm whether the client wants tracking after the engagement ends.
